title: Rejoining a Lapsed Loop+ Membership
content:
A Loop+ Membership lapses when every retry of a declined renewal has failed; its benefits stop on its end date. This guidance governs rejoining that membership.

## Rule

A lapsed membership may be rejoined only within the reactivation window counted in calendar days from the end date; rejoining charges a fresh first charge of the plan's fee, starts a new billing cycle on the rejoin date and, when the plan's reactivation keeps tenure setting is true, keeps the original start date for tenure caps. After the window the buyer signs up again as a new membership with no trial when the trial lookback applies.

## The rejoin window

- **Starting point.** The window is counted from the end date the lapsed membership's own record shows, the date its benefits stopped. The record is the authority, and the rejoin is made on that same membership.
- **Counting.** Calendar days, using the plan's reactivation window.
- **Comparison.** The rejoin date must be no later than the end date plus the reactivation window in calendar days; a rejoin on the last day of the window is within it.
- **When the window has passed.** The lapsed membership can no longer be rejoined and ends as cancelled; the buyer signs up again as a new membership, with no trial when the trial lookback applies.

## What rejoining does

| Element | Effect of a rejoin within the window |
|---|---|
| Status | the membership becomes active again |
| Charge | a fresh first charge of the plan's fee |
| Billing cycle | a new cycle starts on the rejoin date |
| Tenure | the original start date is kept for tenure caps when the plan's reactivation keeps tenure setting is true |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical dates, on a plan whose reactivation window is 30 days)

A membership lapsed with an end date of 2 May. Counting 30 calendar days from 2 May gives 1 June.

- A rejoin on 1 June is within the window: a fresh first charge of the plan's fee is made, a new billing cycle starts on 1 June, and the original start date is kept for tenure caps where the plan keeps tenure.
- A rejoin attempt on 2 June is after the window: the lapsed membership cannot be rejoined, and the buyer signs up again as a new membership.
